summary: Strengthens PCAE's local governance bootstrap so contributors and AI agents automatically receive local governance protections on a fresh clone, before any future Permission Broker command-path integration. pcae init now automatically installs local Git hooks (core.hooksPath=.githooks) in the same step as scaffold creation, when run inside a Git repository -- collapsing the previously two-step (pcae init + pcae hooks install) bootstrap into one documented step. Added .githooks/pre-push, which runs pcae health, pcae check, pcae doctor task-memory, and pcae push check before every push under set -eu, blocking a push if any governance check fails; never executes repository code, never invokes the Permission Broker, never mutates repository state -- confirmed live when this phase's own final push ran the hook automatically and it correctly allowed the push through. Added pcae.core.hooks.diagnose_hooks() reporting one of six states with exact remediation guidance, surfaced via pcae hooks status and pcae doctor hooks (new commands, joining the existing doctor diagnostic family). install_hooks()'s existing behavior and message format are preserved exactly -- tests/test_hooks.py (5 tests) and tests/test_init.py (18 tests) pass unmodified. Updated docs/INSTALLATION.md (new Hook troubleshooting table) and docs/CONTRIBUTOR_WORKFLOW.md to describe the real bootstrap process. Fresh-clone bootstrap validated end-to-end via a real local git clone (no network access). Added docs/PHASE_108_LOCAL_GOVERNANCE_BOOTSTRAP_HARDENING.md. 25 new tests. Hook-focused group (43), governance/autonomy group (1054), and release/lifecycle regression group (1458) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4390/4390 (matches documented baseline). No group required a sequential fallback.

no_go_confirmation: No runtime execution. No Permission Broker command-path integration. No shell mediation. No subprocess mediation. No backend invocation. No adapter invocation. No Telegram inbound. No execution enablement. No execution capability. No audit persistence. No rollback execution. No emergency stop. No CI required-status-check enforcement. No GitHub branch-protection changes. No Permission Broker enforcement. No automatic execution. No command execution. No automatic apply. The pre-push hook itself never executes repository code, never invokes the Permission Broker, and never mutates repository state -- verified both by source inspection tests and by observing it run live on this phase's own final push. v0.1.0-rc1 remains non-executing by design. v0.2 remains the autonomy target (Level 3, not Level 4/5).
